title: Milestone ownership heatmap and roll-forward plan
summary: Compact, heatmap-style tracker focused on owner accountability, current blocker triage, and explicit roll-forward actions for delayed inference rollouts. Designed to feed QBR slides and renewal health checks.
body:
Purpose:
This is a working tracker / heatmap intended for weekly CS -> Solutions syncs and monthly QBR prep. It prioritizes clear ownership for each milestone, explicit blockers (who is working the ticket + ETA), and a roll-forward plan for any milestone that slips beyond its target date. Also includes a renewal risk flag and suggested next actions to reduce churn risk.

How to use:
- Maintain one row per customer milestone group (ingest/test/scale/go-live).
- Owners must keep the blocker cell up-to-date with Jira keys and an ETA.
- Color guidance: GREEN = on track, YELLOW = at-risk (1 blocker), RED = blocked (no clear ETA or >1 critical blocker).
- Add a one-line executive summary for QBR slide cutouts.

Legend (for quick copy into QBR decks):
- Exec line: <customer> — <pct complete> — <health (G/Y/R)> — <next milestone + owner> — <renewal flag (low/medium/high)>

Tracker rows (example entries)
1) Customer: AtlasMed (example)
- Milestone: Data ingest into sandbox (S1)
- Target date: 2026-03-10
- Owner: Marco Chen
- Status: YELLOW (65% complete)
- Blockers: JIRA-CCUST-4821 (schema mismatch between prod and sandbox sample); data team needs to sanitize 120k rows; ETA for remediation: 2026-03-03 (assigned to customer data eng)
- Roll-forward plan: If not resolved by 2026-03-05, CS to schedule daily 30-min unblock calls and escalate to Solutions Engineering for ad-hoc ETL script.
- Renewal flag: medium (customer expects first production pilot in May; delays push renewal discussion risk).
- Next actions: Marco to secure dedicated ETL window w/ customer (owner: Marco, due 2026-03-02).

2) Customer: BrightLedger
- Milestone: 1st inference perf sweep on Dedicated (S2)
- Target date: 2026-02-20
- Owner: Lena Morales
- Status: RED (20% complete)
- Blockers: Internal infra quota not increased; cloud quota request stalled (GCP case 12345678). Also test harness flaky under long sequences.
- Blocker owners: infra quota (Platform Eng triage, owner: Kurt Zhao, ETA 2026-03-01), harness flakiness (Applied ML, owner: Priya Rao, ETA 2026-02-28).
- Roll-forward plan: Defer perf sweep by one week contingent on infra quota, run narrow scope sweep (shorter sequences) in the meantime to keep momentum.
- Renewal flag: high (BrightLedger tied to enterprise deal renewal in June).
- Next actions: Lena to coordinate with Platform Eng weekly standup and produce a scope-limited sweep plan by 2026-02-25.

3) Customer: NovaRetail
- Milestone: Canary go-live (S3)
- Target date: 2026-03-15
- Owner: Devon O'Neill
- Status: GREEN (80% complete)
- Blockers: none critical. Minor rollout docs pending (owner: Solutions Eng).
- Roll-forward plan: on-track; schedule canary review with SRE for 48-hour burn-in starting 2026-03-15.
- Renewal flag: low.
- Next actions: Devon to confirm observability dashboard retention setting (due 2026-03-10).

Risk taxonomy (how we tag renewal impact):
- low: rollout >95% on time, no infra blockers, customer satisfied with perf metrics.
- medium: any single critical blocker causing >2 week delay or repeated test failures.
- high: blocked status for >2 weeks OR delays intersecting with contractual milestones tied to payment or renewal negotiations.

Escalation playbook (short):
- Step 1 (CS owner): capture blocker + Jira + owner + ETA, propose immediate mitigation (workaround or scope narrowing).
- Step 2 (Day 2 if unchanged): schedule cross-team call including Platform Eng / Applied ML / Resource owner. Post a 1-page action tracker in the Jira ticket comments.
- Step 3 (Day 5 if unchanged or high-impact): raise to Customer Success Lead + Solutions Eng manager + Account Executive for exec outreach to customer.

Operational notes and templates to copy into Jira or Confluence:
- Suggested daily unblock comment template: "[CS] Snapshot: blocker <JIRA-XXXX>; impacted milestone <S1/S2/S3>; current ETA <YYYY-MM-DD>; proposed mitigation: <short action>. Owner(s): <name(s)>. Next sync: <date/time>"
- Suggested subject line for escalation emails: "Action required: <Customer> inference rollout blocker — <short title>"

Weekly sync agenda (15–20 minutes):
- Quick heatmap review (3 min)
- 2 rapid unblock updates (8 min)
- Confirm next actions and owners (4 min)
- Any exec outreach needed? (2–5 min)

QBR slide cutouts (example text snippets):
- "AtlasMed — 65% complete — YELLOW — Next: data ingest remediation (Marco Chen) — Renewal: Medium"
- "BrightLedger — 20% complete — RED — Next: infra quota & narrow perf sweep (Lena Morales) — Renewal: High"

Notes to self (authoring CS):
- Keep the heatmap short; prefer two lines per customer in slide decks.
- When marking RED, attach the JIRA key and a clear ETA or the row will be ignored in exec review.
- Use this doc as the single source before copying into the QBR template.

Appendix: quick CSV export format (one line per milestone)
- customer, milestone_id, milestone_name, target_date, owner, status(G/Y/R), percent_complete, blockers(jira keys), blocker_owner, blocker_eta, rollforward_action, renewal_flag, notes

Last updated notes: 2026-02-28 by Aisha Patel — migration of ad-hoc notes into structured heatmap. Next maintenance: 2026-03-03 after CS weekly sync.
